notes: stage 4 position of mg90-d on dev-v006-2A-D, no capture of its own: stage 3's pot-table sitting servo-camera-9 through oscnb.potframes (21 chains, 5 V) and load/ladder-1's still windows. One sitting, one servo. Lookup: knots every lookup_pitch_counts counts, angle in deg, linear between, fitted as tag = PWL(pot) + one offset per moving segment with the rest points at offset 0 and a second-difference ridge of 0.1; end lines pinned at the last knots, slopes through the drive starts past the table, carried as knots guard to guard (results/<pair>.lookup.csv). Held out: two folds by the parity of a chain's rank in its clip kind; scored on every frame with tag speed over 2 deg/s inside the table's range; lead = the pot re-read at host_cam (stage 3's stamp lead per direction group, the capture tool's); value pooled, bounds the two folds. Shares: the pooled error's mean square taken out in the order lead, kind-by-direction means, segment wander, the rest the table's. direction_contrast, speed_free_half_width, timing_slope: position-controlled reads over all kinds, +/- bootstrap sd over segments (400 draws, seed 0). Rows: one per tick; the angle through stage 3's table inverted. Noise the sd over rest windows (baselines less 4000 rows, still coast tails, still ladder windows), value the baselines, bounds the three sources; pattern = mean by tick mod 16, its share 1 - (sd without it / sd)^2, pp bounds include stage 1's divider. Filters: noise the rms over windows of the output's sd from 20 ms in, delay the DC group delay, lag at the passes' tag speed (results/<pair>.filters.csv). Carries: codes 3 LSB wide or with 2+ missing after them, blind span (width - 1) / scale; near / far against the tag with each segment's far median out; hold +/-12 counts, delay its dwell median and range. Direction: boxcar 16 less the tag along the motion on steady crawl holds, value pooled, bounds the two chain-parity folds; clip min/max over the crawl clips' hold means; rest after a coast by arrival, +/- se; bounds: max |crawl clip mean| and |rest mean| + 2 sd, each rounded to 0.1 deg; late ms of the pot source at 4 and 6 counts over four reversals, value the worst. Wide codes: every pot row on a stuck code of the board's stage 1 wide-codes result gains slot / 16 counts before the frames are made; the code widths and the carry list are read on the raw codes. wide_code_band_less_flanks: per crossing, held out, lead applied, nothing out, the mean error of the frames over half on the stuck code less that of the same segment's frames under a tenth on it within 12 counts of the span; _raw the raw readings through a lookup fitted on them, else the route of record; +/- se over crossings; flat_sd the sd of the same contrast on stretches of 11 codes with no carry within 48 counts.

gaps: The direction term: crawl segments in both directions over the same span, each direction started from both ends, with a marker driven from the PWM timer in the camera's view so the stamp lead is measured
The high end: rest points every 2 deg from -30 to -16 deg, or one slow pass that runs to the guard
The carries outside the covered codes: one slow pass guard to guard
Between sittings: the opening pass and 20 rest points repeated in a second sitting, graded through this lookup
Temperature: rest points at two bed temperatures on the heated rig
Side load and torque: the load ladder's holds with the tag in view
Wear of the track: the between-sittings capture repeated over the servo's running life
